title: Living Darkness
answer: Darkness is a living force claimed by the Hollow Court. Outside its mindscape it slowly replaces vulnerable terrain. Unaligned beings suffer a particle-hidden Wither aura; infected players regenerate darkness energy. An Eclipse Scar can call a finite Hollowed patrol against nearby outsiders. During a Dark Eclipse, aligned minds gain strength while Force Pressure drains intruders. Pure Light contact triggers a catastrophic clash. Celestial Ruin and a powered cardinal-amethyst ceremony are the strongest containment tools.
